notes.title: Moonfall Version 1.05 has been launched
notes.notes:
Moonfall star magician version 1.05 has been launched

Meanwhile, the moonfall replacement package mod has also been updated to v1.05 in the player community

Compared with the original version, the new contents include:


Language support

New support language, traditional Chinese


Program optimization

The frame rate is stabilized, so that it can run more stably in the computer environment with older configuration.

Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash

Fixed bug that the game could not leave the main menu due to archiving

Improved connection mechanism with steamwork

Fixed compatibility with previous demo versions


Error repair

At present, all CG can be unlocked stably

Fixed some text errors

Fixed some audio playback problems

Fixed other unspeakable problems


Future update plan:

We plan to support English in the next version v1.1

Moon falling replaces mod. Please join the player community
